paragraphs.raw_text: DOC_ID: ATL-0001 EVENT_ID: NONE TITLE: Country profile: Utgard SOURCE_NAME: Realm Trade Ministry SOURCE_TYPE: atlas RELIABILITY: 1 PUB_DATE: 2024-01-15 PUB_TIME: 10:15 COUNTRY: Utgard SECTOR: general LANGUAGE: en --- Country profile: Utgard

[P1] Utgard is a large factory economy and importer on the East Sea. It assembles computer chips and consumer goods and relies on imported energy, grain and copper ore to keep its plants and population supplied.

[P2] The country's main exports are computer chips and consumer goods. Its main imports are LNG, grain and copper ore. Utgard Terminal is the principal container port and handles both finished goods and industrial inputs.

[P3] Wolf Logistics, a freight forwarder, is the best-known transport firm. The country has a dense network of industrial estates around the capital and a smaller cluster of supplier factories near the terminal.
[P4] The main estates sit within an hour of the terminal. A rail freight line carries containers to inland depots, and several supplier parks have grown up around the larger plants.
